video_meta.title: Who Has Better Smell & Taste: Men or Women?
video_meta.description: Who actually has sharper senses according to real scientific studies: men or women? We breakdown the olfactory bulb neural differences, supertasters, and evolutionary biology in a fun, fair comparison! #science #biology #facts #menvswomen #psychology

thumbnail.background_prompt: [Masterpiece, Best Quality] A detailed 2D digital illustration, split-screen comparison composition, monochromatic dark grey and charcoal crosshatched background. On the left side, a stick-figure woman character in a bright red sweater sniffing a flower with glowing scent trails. On the right side, a stick-figure man character in a bright blue shirt looking confused while sniffing a cup of coffee. Warm spotlighting on both figures. At the very top center, baked directly into the image in large, bold, striking, clean, legible, correctly spelled white sans-serif headline text with a heavy black outline: "WHO SENSES BETTER?". Directly below it, a smaller bold subtitle line in clean white sans-serif text with black outline reads: "WOMEN VS MEN". Sharp lines, minimal noise.
